name: Plant roots
description: Living roots of the shortgrass steppe vegetation (dominated by blue grama, Bouteloua gracilis), the plant-based energy channel of the soil web. Functional group aggregating the roots of all plant species, measured by the source as a single below-ground pool. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
